layout_math.desktop_split: Hero column approximately 1.6x login column; login card remains compact and aligned to optical center.
layout_math.mobile_split: Hero remains first, scaled down; login follows with no overlap.

geometry.hero: Unframed scene, no visible rectangular border or glass card around the flame.
geometry.flame: Actual extruded 3D object inspired by the Halo Fire logo flame silhouette. Entire flame and halo must fit inside hero safe zone; no top halo clip, no bottom flame crop.
geometry.login: Single glass panel, max width around 430px, no nested cards.

scale.hero_to_card: Hero visual may be larger than the card but should not dominate the whole viewport or collide with the login panel.
scale.logo: Logo visible in header and login card; not oversized in the hero.
scale.controls: Inputs and sign-in button use consistent modular sizing and stable heights.

clipping.desktop: Codex preview screenshot confirms animated halo/flame bounds remain inside visible viewport and stage.
clipping.mobile: Hero height constrained; no canvas or flame overlap with login form.

interaction.drag: Pointer drag must tug/stretch the 3D flame object like fabric or elastic glass, not rotate the whole display.
interaction.hover: Hover should energize the flame/halo material without changing layout bounds.
interaction.click: Click should create a pulse through the flame and halo.

color.palette: Black glass base, warm fire amber/red, official Halo Fire mark, blue header wordmark retained only from logo/brand lockup.
color.dominant_hue_rule: Avoid one-note red/orange page; use black glass and restrained amber accent.
color.contrast: Form labels, inputs, and CTA must stay legible over glass.
